organization_goal: earn customer trust by protecting personal data

kpis.text: Personal data fields with a recorded legal basis

tasks: Maintain a data inventory with purpose and retention per field
Mask personal data in non-production systems
beliefs: Customers expect data to be used only for their orders
constraints: Personal data is retained no longer than its purpose requires

tasks: Register and verify each data subject request
Export or erase the customer's data
constraints: Identity is verified before any data is released

rational_statements.text: Classification is the precondition for every other privacy control, so it is measured at 100%.

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: marketing wanted to keep full purchase histories indefinitely
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: keep aggregated histories; delete personal identifiers after 24 months
